claims_to_verify: Folding the detrended 2-min PDCSAP flux at P=7.34932 d, t0=1544.5091 BTJD shows a ~400 ppm, ~1.6 h dip (file phase_fold_P7.34932_15min_bins.csv; re-derive from the light-curve CSV).
All 20 individual transit windows in the 2-min data show a flux decrease (per_transit_depths.csv); weighted-mean depth ~403 +- 31 ppm; chi2_red of per-transit depths ~1.0.
Per-sector depths are consistent: S9 ~385, S62 ~430, S63 ~480, S89 ~490, S90 ~460, S99 ~495 ppm.
No secondary eclipse at phase 0.5 (expect ~-75 +- 34 ppm, i.e. consistent with zero).
Odd and even transits agree within ~2.3 sigma (315 +- 49 vs 463 +- 40 ppm).
The dip is present in the raw SAP flux too (SAP/PDCSAP depth ratio ~1.08) and the background is normal during transits.

A BLS or TLS periodogram over 0.5-70 d on the detrended data with the 3.4476-d candidate masked has its strongest peak at 7.349 d (SDE ~11); an unmasked search still finds 7.349 d among the top peaks together with 3.4476 d.

The same ephemeris predicts dips of ~450-550 ppm in the TESS-SPOC/QLP full-frame-image light curves of sectors 35 and 36 (not included here; fetch via lightkurve: search_lightcurve('TIC 286763141', author='TESS-SPOC')).

SPOC's own multi-sector (s0001-s0096) DV report lists TCE 00286763141-01 at P=7.34932 d, depth 468.8 +- 48 ppm, MES 10.2, 19 transits, bootstrap false-alarm 2.05e-25, centroid offset 5.7 +- 3.9 arcsec (on target), 'TOI 6284: No Ephemeris Match' (file spoc_dv_summary_tce01_s0001-s0096.pdf; MAST product tess2018206190142-s0001-s0096-0000000286763141-01-01071_dvs.pdf).
The signal is not in the ExoFOP TOI list, CTOI list, or NASA Exoplanet Archive as of 2026-10-08/09 (check https://exofop.ipac.caltech.edu/tess/target.php?id=286763141).

how_data_were_processed.normalization: each sector divided by its median PDCSAP flux
how_data_were_processed.detrending: wotan biweight, window 0.6 d, edge_cutoff 0.1 d, break_tolerance 0.3 d; flares clipped at +3 MAD only

reproduce_from_scratch: pip install lightkurve wotan transitleastsquares; lc = lightkurve.search_lightcurve('TIC 286763141', author='SPOC', exptime=120).download_all(); stitch, flatten (window 0.6 d), mask TOI-6284.01 transits, then run astropy BoxLeastSquares or transitleastsquares over 0.5-70 d.
